# yba_perf_advisor_endpoint (Resource)

~> **Preview:** This resource wraps a YugabyteDB Anywhere Perf Advisor API marked preview, which may change in backward-incompatible ways across YBA releases. It also requires Perf Advisor online mode to be enabled for the customer (`yb.ui.feature_flags.enable_pa_online_mode`), which is off by default; every call below is refused while it is off.

Perf Advisor Endpoint resource. Defines an external Perf Advisor that universes registered in online mode send their collected data to, attached to a universe via `yba_universe_perf_advisor_registration`.

~> **Validation Note:** YBA probes both endpoints from a Perf Advisor collector before storing anything, so an unreachable URL or a rejected credential fails the apply rather than surfacing later as silently dropped data. A destination that is temporarily down therefore cannot be created or edited.

~> **Drift Note:** Passwords are read back masked, so they are not reconciled against the server. Everything else is. A password changed out-of-band in the YBA UI is not detected as drift; re-apply from Terraform to restore the intended value.

~> **Security Note:** Endpoint passwords are stored in the Terraform state file (marked sensitive). Use a secure backend and restrict access to your state files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A customer-run Perf Advisor reached directly.
#
# YBA probes both endpoints from a Perf Advisor collector before storing
# anything, so a destination that is unreachable or rejects these credentials
# fails the apply rather than silently dropping data later.
resource "yba_perf_advisor_endpoint" "standalone" {
  name = "perf-advisor-prod"
  type = "BYOC"

  collection_endpoint = "https://perf-advisor.example.com:9443"
  collection_auth {
    type     = "BASIC"
    username = var.pa_username
    password = var.pa_password
  }

  metrics_endpoint = "https://perf-advisor.example.com:9443/api/v1/otlp/metrics"
  metrics_type     = "otlphttp"
  metrics_auth {
    type     = "BASIC"
    username = var.pa_username
    password = var.pa_password
  }
}

# The BYOC ingest gateway, which identifies the sending account and project by
# header rather than by credential. Both identifiers are required there and are
# sent on the metrics and the collection endpoint alike.
resource "yba_perf_advisor_endpoint" "byoc" {
  name = "byoc-prod"
  type = "BYOC"

  collection_endpoint = "https://byoc.cloud.yugabyte.com"
  collection_auth {
    type     = "BASIC"
    username = var.byoc_ingest_username
    password = var.byoc_ingest_password
  }

  metrics_endpoint = "https://byoc.cloud.yugabyte.com/api/v1/otlp/metrics"
  metrics_type     = "otlphttp"
  metrics_auth {
    type     = "BASIC"
    username = var.byoc_ingest_username
    password = var.byoc_ingest_password
  }

  ybm_account_id = var.ybm_account_id
  ybm_project_id = var.ybm_project_id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `collection_endpoint` (String) URL of the destination's Collection API, where everything other than metrics goes.
- `metrics_endpoint` (String) URL the collector sends metrics to.
- `name` (String) Name of the endpoint. Unique per customer.

### Optional

- `collection_auth` (Block List, Max: 1) Credentials for the collection endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--collection_auth))
- `metrics_auth` (Block List, Max: 1) Credentials for the metrics endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metrics_auth))
- `metrics_type` (String) Metrics protocol. One of otlphttp, remotewrite.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `type` (String) Endpoint kind. One of BYOC, PA_ONLINE. PA_ONLINE is reserved for the Yugabyte-hosted service and is rejected by YBA until that exists.
- `ybm_account_id` (String) YugabyteDB Managed account ID, sent as the YBM-Account-ID header on both endpoints. Required by a BYOC ingest gateway, and left unset for a plain Perf Advisor.
- `ybm_project_id` (String) YugabyteDB Managed project ID, sent as the YBM-Project-ID header on both endpoints.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `universe_uuids` (List of String) Universes currently registered in online mode against this endpoint.

- `username` (String) Username. Required for BASIC.
